Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n338\t            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n339\t            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n340\t        };\n341\t\n342\t        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n343\t        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n344\t            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n345\t            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n346\t            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n347\t            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n348\t        };\n349\t\n350\t        // Subdivide\n351\t        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n352\t            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n353\t            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n354\t\n355\t            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n356\t                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n357\t                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n358\t                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n359\t\n360\t                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n361\t                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n362\t                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n363\t                vertices.push_back(mid);\n364\t                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n365\t                return idx;\n366\t            };\n367\t\n368\t            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n369\t                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n370\t                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n371\t                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n372\t\n373\t                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n374\t                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n375\t                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n376\t                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n377\t            }\n378\t            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n379\t        }\n380\t\n381\t        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n382\t        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n383\t        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n384\t            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n385\t            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n386\t        }\n387\t    }\n388\t};\n389\t\n390\t// ============================================================================\n391\t// Random Number Generation\n392\t// ============================================================================\n393\t\n394\tclass RandomGenerator {\n395\t    std::mt19937 rng;\n396\t    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\n397\tpublic:\n398\t    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n399\t    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n400\t};\n401\t\n402\t// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n403\tVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n404\t    val_t u = rng.rand();\n405\t    val_t v = rng.rand();\n406\t    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n407\t        u = 1.0f - u;\n408\t        v = 1.0f - v;\n409\t    }\n410\t    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n411\t    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n412\t    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n413\t}\n414\t\n415\t// ============================================================================\n416\t// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n417\t// ============================================================================\n418\t\n419\tval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n420\t                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n421\t    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n422\t    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n423\t    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n424\t    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n425\t\n426\t    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427\t\n428\t    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429\t    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430\t    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431\t    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432\t\n433\t    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434\t    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435\t    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n436\t\n437\t    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n438\t}\n439\t\n440\t// ============================================================================\n441\t// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442\t// ============================================================================\n443\t\n444\t// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n445\t// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\n446\tbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n447\t                  const Octree& octree,\n448\t                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n449\t    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n450\t    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n451\t    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n452\t    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n453\t\n454\t    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n455\t        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n456\t\n457\t        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n458\t        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n459\t            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n460\t        }\n461\t        return false;\n462\t    });\n463\t}\n464\t\n465\t// ============================================================================\n466\t// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n467\t// ============================================================================\n468\t\n469\t// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n470\tval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n471\t    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472\t    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473\t    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474\t}\n475\t\n476\t// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n477\tval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n478\t                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n479\t                  const Octree& octree,\n480\t                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481\t    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482\t    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483\t\n484\t    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485\t    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486\t\n487\t    val_t kij = ZERO;\n488\t\n489\t    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490\t        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491\t        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492\t\n493\t        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494\t\n495\t        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n496\t        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n497\t        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n498\t\n499\t        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n500\t        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501\t\n502\t        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503\t\n504\t        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505\t    }\n506\t\n507\t    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n508\t}\n509\t\n510\t// ============================================================================\n511\t// Tau (time delay) Computation\n512\t// ============================================================================\n513\t\n514\tint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n515\t    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n516\t    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t// ============================================================================\n520\t// Room Response Simulation State\n521\t// ============================================================================\n522\t\n523\tstruct SimulationState {\n524\t    size_t numTriangles;\n525\t    size_t numTimesteps;\n526\t\n527\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n528\t    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n529\t    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n530\t    std::vector<val_t> radiosity (T x N matrix)\n533\t    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n534\t    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n535\t\n536\t Initialization\n546\t// ============================================================================\n547\t\n548\tvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t state.numTriangles;\n556\t\n557\t    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n558\t\n559\t    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n560\t    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n561\t    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n562\t\n563\t    // Initialize areas\n564\t    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n565\t    for (size_t i = 0; i ============================================================================\n588\t// Precomputation Phase\n589\t// (Kij)...\\n\");\n593\t    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n594\t\n595\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n596\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n597\t || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n602\t            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n603\t        }\n604\t    }\n605\t}\n606\t\n607\tvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n608\t    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n609\t\n610\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n611\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n612\t            if (i == j) continue;\n613\t            state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeTau(\n614\t                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n615\t        }\n616\t    }\n617\t}\n618\t\n619\t// ============================================================================\n620\t// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n621\t// ============================================================================\n622\t\n623\tvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n624\t    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n625\t\n626\t    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n627\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n628\t            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n629\t\n630\t            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n631\t                if (i == j) continue;\n632\t\n633\t                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n634\t\n635\t                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n636\t                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n637\t\n638\t                val_t kij = size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n643\t                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n644\t                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n645\t\n646\t radiosity: reflection + emission\n651\t            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n652\t        }\n653\t\n654\t        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n655\t            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n656\t        }\n657\t    }\n658\t}\n659\t\n660\t// validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n696\t    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n697\t\n698\t    // Check that distances are non-negative\n699\t    bool allNonNegative = true;\n700\t    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n701\t    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n702\t    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n703\t    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n704\t\n705\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n706\t        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n707\t        if (d < 0) {\n708\t            allNonNegative = false;\n709\t            printf(\"  ERROR: EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n719\t    }\n720\t\n721\t    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n722\t    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist /    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n727\t    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n728\t        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n729\t    }\n730\t\n731\t    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n732\t    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n733\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n734\t printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n746\t        return false;\n747\t    }\n748\t\n749\t    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n750\t    int nonZeroKij = 0;\n751\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n752\t        if (state.kij[i] > EPSILON) nonZeroKij++;\n753\t    }\n754\t    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n755\t           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n756\t           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n757\t\n758\t    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n759\t        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n760\t        return false;\n761\t    }\n762\t\n763\t    if (!allNonNegative) {\n764\t        return false;\n765\t    }\n766\t\n767\t    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n768\t    return true;\n769\t}\n770\t\n771\t// { return x * o.x + y * o.y + z * o.z; }\n    Vec3 cross(const Vec3& o) const {\n        return {y * o.z - z * o.y, z * o.x - x * o.z, x * o.y - y * o.x};\n    }\n\n    val_t squaredNorm() const { return x * x + y * y + z * z; }\n    val_t norm() const { return std::sqrt(squaredNorm()); }\n    Vec3 normalized() const {\n        val_t n = norm();\n        return n > EPSILON ? *this / n : Vec3();\n    }\n\n    bool operator==(const Vec3& o) const {\n        return std::abs(x - o.x) < EPSILON && std::abs(y - o.y) < EPSILON && std::abs(z - o.z) < EPSILON;\n    }\n};\n\nstruct Triangle {}\n\n    Vec3 center() const { return (a + b + c) / 3.0f; }\n    Vec3 normal() const { return _normal; }\n\n    val_t area() const {\n        Vec3 ab = b - a;\n        Vec3 ac = c - a;\n        return 0.5f * ab.cross(ac).norm();\n    }\n\n    bool operator==(const Triangle& o) const { return a == o.a && b == o.b && c == o.c; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Triangle-Box Overlap Test (for octree construction)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Separating axis test for triangle-box overlap\nbool triangleBoxOverlap(const Vec3& boxCenter, const Vec3& boxHalfSize, const Triangle& tri) {\n    // Translate triangle to box center\n    Vec3 v0 = tri.a - boxCenter;\n    Vec3 v1 = tri.b - boxCenter;\n    Vec3 v2 = tri.c - boxCenter;\n\n    // Triangle edges\n    Vec3 e0 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e1 = v2 - v1;\n    Vec3 e2 = v0 - v2;\n\n    // Test box normals (AABB axes)\n    auto minMax3 = [](val_t a, val_t b, val_t c) {\n        return std::make_pair(std::min({a, b, c}), std::max({a, b, c}));\n    };\n\n    auto [minX, maxX] = minMax3(v0.x, v1.x, v2.x);\n    if (minX > boxHalfSize.x || maxX < -boxHalfSize.x) return false;\n\n    auto [minY, maxY] = minMax3(v0.y, v1.y, v2.y);\n    if (minY > boxHalfSize.y || maxY < -boxHalfSize.y) return false;\n\n    auto [minZ, maxZ] = minMax3(v0.z, v1.z, v2.z);\n    if (minZ > boxHalfSize.z || maxZ < -boxHalfSize.z) return false;\n\n    // Test triangle normal\n    Vec3 triNormal = e0.cross(e1);\n    val_t d = triNormal.dot(v0);\n    val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(triNormal.x) +\n              boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(triNormal.y) +\n              boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(triNormal.z);\n    if (std::abs(d) > r) return false;\n\n    // Test 9 edge cross products\n    auto testAxis = [&](const Vec3& axis) {\n        val_t p0 = axis.dot(v0);\n        val_t p1 = axis.dot(v1);\n        val_t p2 = axis.dot(v2);\n        val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(axis.x) +\n                  boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(axis.y) +\n                  boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(axis.z);\n        auto [minP, maxP] = minMax3(p0, p1, p2);\n        return !(minP > r || maxP < -r);\n    };\n\n    Vec3 axes[3] = {{1,0,0}, {0,1,0}, {0,0,1}};\n    Vec3 edges[3] = {e0, e1, e2};\n    for (const auto& axis : axes) {\n        for (const auto& edge : edges) {\n            Vec3 crossAxis = axis.cross(edge);\n            if (crossAxis.squaredNorm() > EPSILON) {\n                if (!testAxis(crossAxis)) return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n\nconstexpr size_t MAX_OCTREE_TRIS = 8;\nconstexpr val_t MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE = 0.5f;\n\nclass Octree {\npublic:\n    Vec3 minBound, maxBound;\n    Vec3 halfExtent, center;\n    std::unique_ptr<Octree> children[8];\n    std::vector<size_t> triangleIndices;  // Indices into the global triangle list\n    const std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles\n\n    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n\n    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n        allTriangles = &triangles;\n        if (triangles.empty()) return;\n\n        // Compute bounding box\n        minBound = triangles[0].a;\n        maxBound = triangles[0].a;\n        for (const auto& tri : triangles) {\n            for (const auto* v : {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {\n                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);\n                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);\n                minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);\n                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);\n                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);\n                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Collect all indices\n        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;\n\n        buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);\n    }\n\nprivate:\n    void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {\n        minBound = nodeMin;\n        maxBound = nodeMax;\n        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;\n        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n\n        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Subdivide into 8 children\n        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n\n        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n\n            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n\n                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n        bool canSplit = false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n                canSplit = true;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!canSplit) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Build children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n                Vec3 childMin = center;\n                Vec3 childMax = center;\n                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n\n                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\npublic:\n    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box\n    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {\n        Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n\n        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n    template<typename Func>\n    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n      }\n\n        // Otherwise, descend to children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n            }\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation\n// ============================================================================\n\nclass RandomGenerator {\n    std::mt19937 rng;\n    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\npublic:\n    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n};\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = rng.rand();\n    val_t v = rng.rand();\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\nval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\nbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n\n        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n        }\n        return false;\n    });\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\nval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n                  const Octree& octree,\n                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI =     return static_cast<val_t>(z >> 40) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);  // [0, 1)\n    }\n};\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nHD Vec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = rng.rand();\n    val_t v = rng.rand();\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n// ============================================================================\n\nHD val_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                              const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Flattened Octree (device-friendly) and Visibility Testing\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct GpuNode {\n    Vec3 center, halfExtent;\n    int child[8];\n    int triStart, triCount;  // triCount > 0 -> leaf\n};\n\nstruct GpuOctree {\n    std::vector<GpuNode> nodes;\n    std::vector<int> leafTris;\n};\n\nstatic int flattenOctree(const Octree& node, GpuOctree& out) {\n    int self = static_cast<int>(out.nodes.size());\n    out.nodes.emplace_back();\n    GpuNode g;\n    g.center = node.center;\n    g.halfExtent = node.halfExtent;\n    g.triStart = static_cast<int>(out.leafTris.size());\n    g.triCount = static_cast<int>(node.triangleIndices.size());\n    for (size_t idx : node.triangleIndices) out.leafTris.push_back(static_cast<int>(idx));\n    for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) g.child[c] = -1;\n    if (g.triCount == 0) {\n        for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n            if (node.children[c]) g.child[c] = flattenOctree(*node.children[c], out);\n        }\n    }\n    out.nodes[self] = g;\n    return self;\n}\n\nstruct DeviceScene {\n    const Triangle* tris;\n    const GpuNode* nodes;\n    const int* leafTris;\n};\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ bool rayIntersectsBox(const GpuNode& n, const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) {\n    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n    Vec3 c = p1 + d - n.center;\n    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};\n    const Vec3& h = n.halfExtent;\n\n    if (fabsf(c.x) > h.x + ad.x) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.y) > h.y + ad.y) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.z) > h.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > h.y * ad.z + h.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > h.z * ad.x + h.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > h.x * ad.y + h.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n__device__ bool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to, const DeviceScene& scene,\n                             int srcTriIdx, int dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    int stack[96];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        const GpuNode& n = scene.nodes[stack[--sp]];\n        if (n.triCount > 0) {\n            for (int k = 0; k < n.triCount; ++k) {\n                int idx = scene.leafTris[n.triStart + k];\n                if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) continue;\n                const Triangle& tri = scene.tris[idx];\n                val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) return true;\n            }\n        } else {\n            for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n                int ci = n.child[c];\n                if (ci >= 0 && rayIntersectsBox(scene.nodes[ci], from, to)) stack[sp++] = ci;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\nHD val_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    return fmaxf(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n}\n\n// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n__device__ val_t computeKij(int idxI, int idxJ, const DeviceScene& scene) {\n    const Triangle triI = scene.tris[idxI];\n    const Triangle triJ = scene.tris[idxJ];\n\n    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n\n    RandomGenerator rng(42, static_cast<uint64_t>(idxI) * 0x100000000ULL + static_cast<uint64_t>(idxJ));\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, scene, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// Stores w = min(Kij * area_j, 1) (0 where Kij <= 0) for the locally owned rows.\n__global__ void formFactorKernel(DeviceScene scene, const val_t* areas, val_t* w,\n                                 unsigned long long* nonZeroCount,\n                                 size_t n, size_t rowBegin, size_t rows) {\n    size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    bool active = p < rows * n;\n    bool nonZero = false;\n    if (active) {\n        size_t i = rowBegin + p / n;\n        size_t j = p % n;\n        val_t kij = ZERO;\n        if (i != j) kij = computeKij(static_cast<int>(i), static_cast<int>(j), scene);\n        w[p] = kij > ZERO ? fminf(kij * areas[j], ONE) : ZERO;\n        nonZero = kij > EPSILON;\n    }\n    unsigned ballot = __ballot_sync(0xffffffffu, nonZero);\n    if ((threadIdx.x & 31) == 0 && ballot) atomicAdd(nonZeroCount, static_cast<unsigned long long>(__popc(ballot)));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nHD int computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(ceilf(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n__global__ void tauKernel(const Triangle* tris, uint8_t* tau, size_t n, size_t rowBegin, size_t rows) {\n    size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (p >= rows * n) return;\n    size_t i = rowBegin + p / n;\n    size_t j = p % n;\n    int t = 0;\n    if (i != j) t = computeTau(tris[i], tris[j]);\n    tau[p] = static_cast<uint8_t>(t > 255 ? 255 : t);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Room Response Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> (T x N matrix), rank 0 only after simulation\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n    GpuOctree gpuOctree;\n\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n    size_t timeOff;                 // Source emits for t < timeOff\n\n    // Row partition (MPI): this rank owns triangles [rowBegin, rowBegin + rows)\n    size_t rowBegin = 0, rows = 0;\n    std::vector<int> counts, displs;\n\n    // Device data\n    Triangle* dTris = nullptr;\n    GpuNode* dNodes = nullptr;\n    int* dLeaf = nullptr;\n    val_t* dAreas = nullptr;\n    val_t* dRho = nullptr;          // local rows\n    val_t* dW = nullptr;            // rows x N\n    uint8_t* dTau = nullptr;        // rows x N\n    val_t* dRadB = nullptr;         // T x N\n    val_t* dDist = nullptr;         // local rows\n    unsigned long long* dNonZero = nullptr;\n    unsigned long long nonZeroKij = 0;  // global count\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", n);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n    ROOT_PRINTF(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n    flattenOctree(state.octree, state.gpuOctree);\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(n);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Row partition across ranks\n    state.counts.resize(g_size);\n    state.displs.resize(g_size);\n    size_t acc = 0;\n    for (int r = 0; r < g_size; ++r) {\n        size_t cnt = n / g_size + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < n % g_size ? 1 : 0);\n        state.counts[r] = static_cast<int>(cnt);\n        state.displs[r] = static_cast<int>(acc);\n        acc += cnt;\n    }\n    state.rowBegin = static_cast<size_t>(state.displs[g_rank]);\n    state.rows = static_cast<size_t>(state.counts[g_rank]);\n\n    // Initialize reflectivity (local rows)\n    state.rho.assign(state.rows, reflectivity);\n    state.distances.assign(n, ZERO);\n\n    // Source emission is active for the first half of timesteps\n    state.timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n\n    // Device allocations\n    size_t need = state.rows * n * (sizeof(val_t) + sizeof(uint8_t)) + timesteps * n * sizeof(val_t);\n    size_t freeMem = 0, totalMem = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&freeMem, &totalMem));\n    if (need > freeMem) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Rank %d: problem needs %.2f GB of device memory but only %.2f GB free; use more ranks\\n\",\n                g_rank, need / 1e9, freeMem / 1e9);\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dTris, n * sizeof(Triangle)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dNodes, state.gpuOctree.nodes.size() * sizeof(GpuNode)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dLeaf, std::max<size_t>(1, state.gpuOctree.leafTris.size()) * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&state.dAreas, n * sizeof(val_t)));\n CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dTris, state.triangles.data(), n * sizeof(Triangle), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dNodes, state.gpuOctree.nodes.data(),\n                          state.gpuOctree.nodes.size() * sizeof(GpuNode), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    if (!state.gpuOctree.leafTris.empty())\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dLeaf, state.gpuOctree.leafTris.data(),\n                              state.gpuOctree.leafTris.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dAreas, state.areas.data(), n * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    if (state.rows)\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.dRho, state.rho.data(), state.rows * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.dRadB, 0, std::max<size_t>(1, timesteps * n) * sizeof(val_t)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.dNonZero, 0, sizeof(unsigned long long)));\n}\n\nvoid releaseDevice(SimulationState& state) {\n    cudaFree(state.dTris);  cudaFree(state.dNodes); cudaFree(state.dLeaf);\n    cudaFree(state.dAreas); cudaFree(state.dRho);   cudaFree(state.dW);\n ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// One warp per local row i; lanes stride over j.\n__global__ void simStepKernel(int t, size_t n, size_t rowBegin, size_t rows,\n                              const uint8_t* __restrict__ tau, const val_t* __restrict__ w,\n                              val_t* radB, const val_t* __restrict__ rho,\n The inner sum\n// keeps the original (ascending tt) order; ties resolve to the smallest lag.\ntemplate <bool kShared>\n__global__ void distanceKernel(const val_t* radB, size_t n, size_t numT, size_t rowBegin,\n                               size_t sourceIndex, val_t* dist) {\n    extern __shared__ val_t series[];  // [pB(T) | pS(T)] when kShared\n    __shared__ val_t redSum[128];\n    __shared__ series + numT;\n        for (size_t tt = threadIdx.x; tt < numT; tt += blockDim.x) {\n            sB[tt] = radB[tt * n + i];\n            sS[tt] = radB[tt * n + sourceIndex];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        pBarr = sB; pSarr = sS; stride = 1;\n        (void)pBarr; (void)pSarr; (void)stride;\n    }\n\n    val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n    int bestT = 0;\n    for (size_t t = threadIdx.x; t < numT; t += blockDim.x) {\n        val_t sum = ZERO;\n        for (size_t tt = t; tt < numT; ++tt) {\n            val_t pB, pS;\n            if (kShared) {\n                pB = series[tt];\n                pS = series[numT + tt - t];\n            } else {\n                pB = radB[tt * n + i];\n                pS = radB[(tt - t) * n + sourceIndex];\n            }\n            sum += pS * pB;\n        }\n        if (sum > maxCorr) {\n            maxCorr = sum;\n            bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n        }\n    }\n    redSum[threadIdx.x] = maxCorr;\n    redT[threadIdx.x] = bestT;\n redT[threadIdx.x], tb = redT[threadIdx.x + s];\n            if (b > a || (b == a && b > ZERO && tb < ta)) {\n                redSum[threadIdx.x] = b;\n                redT[threadIdx.x] = tb;\n ROOT_PRINTF(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n    const size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t numT = state.numTimesteps;\n\n    if (state.rows) {\n        size_t shBytes = 2 * numT * sizeof(val_t);\n        if (shBytes <= 48 * 1024) {\n            distanceKernel<true><<<static_cast<unsigned>(state.rows), 128, shBytes>>>(\n                state.dRadB, n, numT, state.rowBegin, state.sourceIndex, state.dDist);\n        } else {\n            distanceKernel<false><<<static_cast<unsigned>(state.rows), 128, 0>>>(\n                state.dRadB, n, numT, state.rowBegin, state.sourceIndex, state.dDist);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.distances.data() + state.rowBegin, state.dDist,\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg48NUk84saX4f4kQ6UQC","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"`roomsim` is now an MPI + OpenMP + CUDA hybrid. It builds with no warnings and runs, but the results are not bit-identical to the original in every case. That comes from the random-number change described below.\n\n**What changed**\n- **Files:** only `roomsim.cpp` and `CMakeLists.txt` changed, and the executable is still `roomsim`. CMake now compiles the single `.cpp` as CUDA and links MPI, OpenMP and cudart, with no new dependencies.\n- **MPI:** each rank owns a contiguous block of triangle rows and binds to one GPU on its node. The only per-timestep communication is an `MPI_Allgatherv` of that step's radiosity row. The final distances and the form-factor count are exchanged once at the end.\n- **CUDA:**\n  - The form-factor kernel (16 rays per pair, octree traversal) runs on the GPU.\n  - The octree is flattened into arrays for the GPU.\n  - Time delays are computed on the GPU.\n  - The wave step is one warp per row with a shuffle reduction.\n  - The cross-correlation uses one block per triangle and keeps the original summation order and tie-breaking.\n- **OpenMP:** it covers the host-side loops (triangle areas and the validation scan).\n- **Memory:** the N×N form-factor and delay matrices now live only on the GPUs, split across ranks. They are stored compactly, as `min(Kij·area, 1)` and a `uint8` delay. If a rank's share doesn't fit on its GPU, the program says so and asks for more ranks.\n\n**Verification** (4× RTX 3090 here)\n\n| Case | Result vs. original |\n|---|---|\n| `-n 1280 -t 50` | Hash, distance sum, max and the non-zero form-factor count all match. |\n| `-n 20 -t 10 -s 3` | Same hash. |\n| `-n 320 -t 300 -s 7 -r 0.5` | Hash differs. The average distance is 13.98 vs. 14.22, while the non-zero form-factor count is identical. |\n| `-n 5120 -t 100` | Hash differs. |\n\nThe GPU gives the same hash at 1, 3 and 4 ranks in every case I ran.\n\n**The one semantic deviation:** the original draws all random numbers from one sequential `mt19937` stream. That order can't be reproduced in parallel, so each (i,j) pair now uses its own counter-based stream. Kij is still a Monte Carlo estimate with the same distribution. In the two differing cases the estimate shifts slightly, and a few triangles whose cross-correlation peaks are nearly tied pick a different lag. Only an exact-match requirement would be affected.\n\n**Performance**\n- **`-n 20480 -t 100`:** the total went from 20.0 s on 1 GPU to 5.0 s on 4 GPUs, with the form-factor phase dominating.\n- **`-n 1280 -t 50`:** the original sequential build took 26.5 s, versus 0.25 s on 1 GPU and 0.017 s on 4 GPUs.\n\nRun it with one rank per GPU, for example `mpirun -np 4 ./roomsim -n 20480 -t 100 -v`."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":714,"cache_read_input_tokens":72904,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":714},"output_tokens":7,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"35af7b23-8d0a-4fcf-bf27-24a83530102f","uuid":"8187fb26-d065-4c49-9527-d57cdc4d19be","timestamp":"2026-10-15T13:48:42.935Z","request_id":"req_011Cg48NUWUEkp8s73gSccyA"}
